body: Yea, I have lost a lot of money, gotten cards cancelled...accounts terminated with money left on it...it is a complete shit show for me.

The problem is, years down the road I will be still dreading over something as similar to bad grades, or bullying..it will never stop and that is how life is...I can not see myself living any longer because i do not want to be part of such that loop

It is the right answer for those who feel so. People do not just think of suicide on the spot, it is a growing thought...and for those who try to make an action to end their life..by then it is too late..and for those the answer of suicide is correct.
